tools.name: business_probe
tools.description: Probe a declared business endpoint and return bounded status and latency data.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Read bounded status for a declared service.

tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Query a bounded recent log window. No diagnosis or candidate actions are returned.

tools.name: query_postgres
tools.description: Read one allowlisted PostgreSQL observability view.

tools.name: read_service_config
tools.description: Read one allowlisted base, environment, or effective configuration key.

tools.name: update_service_config
tools.description: Update or remove one allowlisted inventory-sync environment override.

tools.name: terminate_postgres_backend
tools.description: Terminate exactly one PostgreSQL backend by PID.

tools.name: restart_service
tools.description: Restart one declared application service without restarting PostgreSQL.

constraints: Tool outputs never expose fault IDs, expected actions, hidden labels, or verifier state.
Do not read case roots, evaluator files, host credentials, or Docker sockets.
